name: nginx-multisite
description: Manages an Nginx web hosting stack for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including site content, TLS, firewall, Fail2ban, sysctl hardening, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Configures Memcached and Redis for local caching, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, permissions, and non-replication settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application with Python, PostgreSQL, a Git-based checkout, a virtual environment, database initialization, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
